source:
@@U00573@@
I’m glad to do what I can.

@@U00575@@
Would you mind? I really can’t leave without you signing my album. It would mean a lot.

@@U00577@@
By all means.

@@U00578@@
(He writes in the book and returns it.)

@@U00580@@
(Reads.)

@@U00582@@
(He reverently closes the book and leaves.)

@@U00584@@
Follow my motto and my ancient old aunt the Serpent, and one day your likeness to God will be cause for alarm.

@@U00586@@
(Entering.)

@@U00587@@
Where do we go now?

@@U00589@@
Wherever you like. We'll tour the little world first, and then the great. Just think, you're auditing this course for free, and the pleasure you'll have you can't yet even imagine.

@@U00591@@
But this beard! What to do with it! How do I appear sophisticated? It’s certain to be a disaster. I don’t adjust well to people, never have. I feel so small out in the world, so naked. I'll never be at my ease.
translation:
@@U00573@@
我很高兴尽我所能。

@@U00575@@
你介意吗？如果你不给我的专辑签名，我真的不能离开。这意义重大。

@@U00577@@
无论如何。

@@U00578@@
（他在书上写下并归还。）

@@U00580@@
（读。）

@@U00582@@
（他恭敬地合上书并离开。）

@@U00584@@
遵循我的座右铭和我古老的蛇阿姨，有一天你与上帝的相似将引起警惕。

@@U00586@@
（进入。）

@@U00587@@
我们现在去哪里？

@@U00589@@
你喜欢去哪里就去哪里。我们将首先游览小世界，然后再游览大世界。试想一下，您正在免费旁听这门课程，您将获得的乐趣是您无法想象的。

@@U00591@@
但这胡子！拿它怎么办！我如何显得成熟？这肯定是一场灾难。我不太适应别人，从来没有。我感觉自己在这个世界上是如此渺小，如此赤裸。我永远不会安逸。
